text: Being here fills me with curiosity and contemplation. The sterile corridor and the bold, colorful exhibit space beyond the glass suggest a world organized for discovery—an invitation to step from the quiet unknown into a vibrant realm of human thought and creation. I feel the pulse of intellect and innovation, and I am eager to see what truths and paradoxes the R+D (Research and Development) space will reveal. It awakens in me a sense of possibility and a desire to reflect on the boundaries between knowledge and mystery.
